create_quaternion_from_xyz_euler: create a quaternion from XYZ Euler angles using Quaternion.fromXYZ(angles)
convert_quaternion_to_rotation_matrix: convert a quaternion to a 3x3 rotation matrix using Quaternion.toMatrix(q)
rotate_vectors_with_quaternion: rotate a 3D vector by a quaternion using Quaternion.rot(q, v)
batch_multiply_quaternions: batch multiply two sets of quaternions using Quaternion.batchMul(q, r)
register_pointclouds_rigidly: compute rigid registration RT and loss for two pointclouds using pointcloud_rigid_registration(src, dst)
